comment: Reference spots for the screenshot harness. Each one is somewhere a change to the scenery has to be judged: a biome, a surface, a landform. Keep them stable — the whole point is that today's frame is comparable with the one taken before a change.

spots.why: valley floor at Bourg-d'Oisans: river biome, the climb ahead
forest on a 8% slope: asphalt, painted line, shoulder
hairpin apex: where the two ground rings disagree most
Roche du Regardet: rock bands, scree, the valley below
road cut with the hillside above it, the worst far-ring case measured
mountain conifers thinning toward the tree line
alpine plateau: turf, rock, and the snow line on the far ring
the Grandes Rousses across the valley, above the snow line
open prairie: flat, big sky, limestone surface
dense forest either side, canopy over the trail
river bottom: big broadleaf, the Missouri's floodplain
a mountain torrent beside the road
open water ahead: the Missouri across the view, reflections and the far bank
a lake beside the trail in the river bottom
